audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Job's remembrance of former days: divine intimacy, household abundance, public honor, rescue of poor/orphan/widow, justice as clothing, and respected counsel.

verses.restored: Job again lifted up his discourse and said:

familiar.text: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

modern.text: And Job continued his discourse:

original.text: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר

verses.restored: If only I were as in the months of old, as in the days when the Divine guarded me,

familiar.text: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

modern.text: “How I long for the months gone by, for the days when God watched over me,

original.text: מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֥נִי כְיַרְחֵי קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי

verses.restored: when his lamp shone over my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

familiar.text: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

modern.text: when His lamp shone above my head, and by His light I walked through the darkness,

original.text: בְּהִלּ֣וֹ נֵ֭רוֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י לְ֝אוֹרוֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ

verses.restored: as I was in the days of my autumn/ripeness, when the intimate counsel of the Divine was over my tent,

familiar.text: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

modern.text: when I was in my prime, when the friendship of God rested on my tent,

original.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּימֵ֣י חָרְפִּ֑י בְּס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אָהֳלִֽי

verses.restored: when Shaddai was still with me, and my children were around me,

familiar.text: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

modern.text: when the Almighty was still with me and my children were around me,

original.text: בְּע֣וֹד שַׁ֭דַּי עִמָּדִ֑י סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣י נְעָרָֽי

verses.restored: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me.

familiar.text: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

modern.text: when my steps were bathed in cream and the rock poured out for me streams of oil!

original.text: בִּרְחֹ֣ץ הֲלִיכַ֣י בְּחֵמָ֑ה וְצ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗י פַּלְגֵי שָֽׁמֶן

verses.restored: When I went out to the gate by the city, when I prepared my seat in the square,

familiar.text: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

modern.text: When I went out to the city gate and took my seat in the public square,

original.text: בְּצֵ֣אתִי שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי קָ֑רֶת בָּ֝רְח֗וֹב אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽי

verses.restored: young men saw me and hid themselves, and elders rose and stood.

familiar.text: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

modern.text: the young men saw me and withdrew, and the old men rose to their feet.

original.text: רָא֣וּנִי נְעָרִ֣ים וְנֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִֽ֝ישִׁישִׁים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ

verses.restored: Princes held back words and laid a hand on their mouth.

familiar.text: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

modern.text: The princes refrained from speaking and covered their mouths with their hands.

original.text: שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְמִלִּ֑ים וְ֝כַ֗ף יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם

verses.restored: The voice of nobles was hidden, and their tongue clung to their palate.

familiar.text: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

modern.text: The voices of the nobles were hushed, and their tongues stuck to the roofs of their mouths.

original.text: קוֹל נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם לְחִכָּ֥ם דָּבֵֽקָה

verses.restored: For the ear heard and blessed me, and the eye saw and bore witness for me,

familiar.text: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

modern.text: For those who heard me called me blessed, and those who saw me commended me,

original.text: כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥יִן רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי

verses.restored: because I rescued the poor who cried out, and the orphan who had no helper.

familiar.text: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

modern.text: because I rescued the poor who cried out and the fatherless who had no helper.

original.text: כִּֽי אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝יָת֗וֹם וְֽלֹא עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ

verses.restored: The blessing of the perishing came upon me, and the heart of the widow I made sing for joy.

familiar.text: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

modern.text: The dying man blessed me, and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.

original.text: בִּרְכַּ֣ת אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣י תָּבֹ֑א וְלֵ֖ב אַלְמָנָ֣ה אַרְנִֽן

verses.restored: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my justice was like a robe and turban.

familiar.text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

modern.text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; justice was my robe and my turban.

original.text: צֶ֣דֶק לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑נִי כִּֽמְעִ֥יל וְ֝צָנִ֗יף מִשְׁפָּטִֽי

verses.restored: I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame.

familiar.text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

modern.text: I served as eyes to the blind and as feet to the lame.

original.text: עֵינַ֣יִם הָ֭יִיתִי לַֽעִוֵּ֑ר וְרַגְלַ֖יִם לַפִּסֵּ֣חַ אָֽנִי

verses.restored: I was a father to the needy, and the case I did not know I searched out.

familiar.text: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

modern.text: I was a father to the needy, and I took up the case of the stranger.

original.text: אָ֣ב אָ֭נֹכִֽי לָֽאֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים וְרִ֖ב לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: I broke the jaws of the unjust and made him drop the prey from his teeth.

familiar.text: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

modern.text: I shattered the fangs of the unjust and snatched the prey from his teeth.

original.text: וָֽ֭אֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וּ֝מִשִּׁנָּ֗יו אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף

verses.restored: Then I said, I shall expire with my nest, and like the sand multiply my days.

familiar.text: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

modern.text: So I thought: ‘I will die in my nest and multiply my days as the sand.

original.text: וָ֭אֹמַר עִם קִנִּ֣י אֶגְוָ֑ע וְ֝כַח֗וֹל אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים

verses.restored: My root was open to waters, and dew lodged all night on my branch.

familiar.text: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

modern.text: My roots will spread out to the waters, and the dew will rest nightly on my branches.

original.text: שָׁרְשִׁ֣י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי מָ֑יִם וְ֝טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּקְצִירִֽי

verses.restored: My glory was fresh with me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

familiar.text: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

modern.text: My glory is ever new within me, and my bow is renewed in my hand.’

original.text: כְּ֭בוֹדִי חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑י וְ֝קַשְׁתִּ֗י בְּיָדִ֥י תַחֲלִֽיף

verses.restored: They listened to me and waited, and they kept silent for my counsel.

familiar.text: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

modern.text: Men listened to me with expectation, waiting silently for my counsel.

original.text: לִֽי שָׁמְע֥וּ וְיִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽי

verses.restored: After my word they did not speak again, and my speech dropped on them.

familiar.text: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

modern.text: After my words, they spoke no more; my speech settled on them like dew.

original.text: אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִי לֹ֣א יִשְׁנ֑וּ וְ֝עָלֵ֗ימוֹ תִּטֹּ֥ף מִלָּתִֽי

verses.restored: They waited for me as for rain, and opened their mouth as for spring rain.

familiar.text: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

modern.text: They waited for me as for rain and drank in my words like spring showers.

original.text: וְיִֽחֲל֣וּ כַמָּטָ֣ר לִ֑י וּ֝פִיהֶ֗ם פָּעֲר֥וּ לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ

verses.restored: I smiled on them when they had no confidence, and the light of my face they did not cast down.

familiar.text: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

modern.text: If I smiled at them, they did not believe it; the light of my countenance was precious.

original.text: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּן

verses.restored: I chose their way and sat as head; I dwelled like a king among troops, like one who comforts mourners.

familiar.text: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

modern.text: I chose their course and presided as chief. So I dwelt as a king among his troops, as a comforter of the mourners.

original.text: אֶֽבֲחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּם֮ וְאֵשֵׁ֪ב רֹ֥אשׁ וְ֭אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּגְּד֑וּד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבֵלִ֣ים יְנַחֵֽם
